verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform, so asking about official SDKs is fair. The evidence shows only a GraphQL Developer API with introspection and a browser playground, which the docs describe as working "without installing any client libraries." No official SDK or client library is documented. The raw API and the GitHub compliance-skills agent skills are adjacent building blocks, not SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
